question: Who does Elisha say will see the grain for sale but won’t eat any of it?

readings.answer: The officer on whose arm the king was leaning
readings.support: The officer on whose arm the king was leaning | You will see it with your own eyes,” answered Elisha, “but you will not eat any of it!

assessments.reason: The passage explicitly identifies “the officer on whose arm the king was leaning,” and Elisha addresses him saying he will see it but not eat any of it; this matches the key exactly.

reason: The text states the officer the king was leaning on would see the prices but not eat, matching the key.
